service.name: My Service
service.description: Example: a compute service where users allocate, run and manage resources

permissions.name: Read Resources
permissions.description: View your own allocations, instances and status
permissions.intent: Basic read access. Required for dashboard access.

permissions.name: Create Allocations
permissions.description: Allocate new compute resources
permissions.intent: Each allocation consumes cloud resources and incurs costs.

permissions.name: Create Deployments
permissions.description: Create new deployments
permissions.intent: Deploy resources via the supported engines.

permissions.name: Modify Resources
permissions.description: Start, stop and modify your own resources

permissions.name: Scale Resources
permissions.description: Scale your own allocations up or down

permissions.name: Delete Resources
permissions.description: Permanently terminate your own allocations
permissions.intent: Termination is irreversible, so it is granted explicitly (team or admin), not to every new user.
permissions.security_notes: Termination stops billing but data cannot be recovered.

permissions.name: Execute in Instances
permissions.description: Run commands inside your own compute environments
permissions.security_notes: Commands are isolated within the allocated container/VM.

permissions.name: Execute in Containers
permissions.description: Run commands inside your own containers

permissions.name: SSH Access
permissions.description: SSH or console into your own instances
permissions.security_notes: Interactive access bypasses structured command logging. Prefer execute for non-interactive commands.

permissions.name: View Logs
permissions.description: View logs from your own resources

permissions.name: View Metrics
permissions.description: View metrics from your own resources

permissions.name: Read Costs
permissions.description: View your own cost reports and usage

permissions.name: Cost Administrator
permissions.description: Org-wide cost data and budgets
permissions.intent: Org-level billing admin inside your own org.

permissions.name: Read Quotas
permissions.description: View your own quota limits and usage

permissions.name: Quota Administrator
permissions.description: Manage quota limits for users in your org

permissions.name: Read Workflows
permissions.description: View workflow definitions

permissions.name: Create Workflows
permissions.description: Create workflow definitions

permissions.name: Execute Workflows
permissions.description: Run workflows (may provision resources and incur costs)

permissions.name: Administrator
permissions.description: Administer every resource inside your own org
permissions.intent: Org-level admin: view, modify, scale, delete ANY resource in the org. Never other orgs.

permissions.name: Read Platform Config
permissions.description: View your service's platform-wide configuration

permissions.name: Platform Administrator
permissions.description: Platform-wide administration of your service
permissions.intent: For your own operators only: system health, configuration.

permissions.name: Cross-Tenant Access
permissions.description: Access resources in any customer's organization
permissions.intent: Support permission. Reaches across every customer.
permissions.security_notes: Log and audit every cross-tenant access. Grant one person at a time with authsetup grant-platform.

roles.name: User
roles.description: Everyday user with access to their own resources

roles.name: Operator
roles.description: Manage resources but not create new ones
